messages:
camila: sharing a quick sketch for the SLO editor: added a 'Multiplier' slider to control notification aggressiveness plus a live routing preview. figma: https://www.figma.com/file/XXXX/slo-multiplier
matt: looks promising. one UX edge: when multiplier > 1 the preview should label channels that will escalate with 'escalates' and use a punchy color. avoid generic 'fast'.
jon: tiny copy ask: instead of 'Multiplier' can we try 'Notify multiplier' or 'Notify aggressiveness'? my PM thought 'Multiplier' sounded mathy.
camila: 'Notify multiplier' is okay. i prefer short labels but we can add an explanatory tooltip: 'How quickly alerts are triggered relative to default.'
liz: Accessibility: slider needs precise keyboard controls. arrow keys should move by 0.1, page up/down by 0.5, home/end to min/max. also aria-live region should announce which channels change state.
aria-bot: Accessibility guidance: ensure slider has role="slider" and exposes aria-valuenow, aria-valuemin, aria-valuemax. Provide aria-live="polite" on the preview summary; avoid verbose output on every tiny change.
matt: preview phrasing: instead of 'Pages: 4 channels' maybe 'Will notify: PD(2), Slack(1), Email(1)'. keeps it structured for screenreaders.
jon: suppressed channels: should we show them in preview? i think yes, show with a muted badge and '(suppressed)'. give users a path to edit quiet windows from there.
camila: agreed. showing suppressed channels helps surface gaps. visually de-emphasize with 60% opacity and small muted icon + tooltip 'suppressed by quiet window'.
liz: keyboard focus: suppressed items must still be part of tab order and reveal the tooltip on focus. tooltips must be accessible (role=tooltip, aria-describedby target).
matt: performance: when dragging fast, throttle preview updates to ~120ms and show a subtle loader in the preview while computing. prevents jumpiness and shows the user something's happening.
camila: good call. also while multiplier is high (>3x) show microcopy: 'Preview approximate — actual routing may change under load or batching.' keeps expectations clear.
jon: color legend suggestion: red/orange = escalates, blue = not urgent notify, gray = suppressed. but check contrast for small text.
aria-bot: Contrast note: orange #FF7A33 might fail for 12px labels on white. either darken the tone or add bold text/outline. ensure focus rings meet contrast in both light/dark themes.
liz: focus ring thickness: use 3px for our tokenized buttons so it remains visible in dark theme.
matt: bug catch: when slider updates via keyboard the preview readout was lumping counts (e.g., 'PagerDuty: 3') without clearing previous state fast enough. unit test candidate: slider change updates aria-live text in under 200ms.
camila: i'll iterate figma with: label change to 'Notify multiplier', tooltip text, keyboard increments, accessible tooltips, legend, suppressed affordance, and throttled preview. will post updated frames tonight.
jon: copy thought: tooltip short text = 'How quickly we escalate SLO burn. 1x is default.' that keeps it simple.
camila: nice. i'll use that microcopy. thanks all. i'll ping when frames are live and link QA tickets.
matt: i'll add a small e2e for the aria-live announcement and a visual test for suppressed state.
aria-bot: Reminder: include keyboard-only walkthrough in the PR description for reviewers.
camila: noted. thanks everyone :raised_hands:
